source_preview:
Job Description: Cloud Engineer (AWS) – Mumbai

Role Overview
We are seeking a Cloud Engineer with 2+ years of experience in AWS to join our team. The
ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of AWS services and operational experience,
and be able to design, build, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure.

Responsibilities

•
Design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable AWS cloud infrastructure.

•
Manage and optimize AWS resources, including EC2 instances, S3 buckets, RDS
databases, and more.

•
Implement and maintain cloud security best practices to protect sensitive data.

•
Automate infrastructure provisioning and management using tools like Terraform or
CloudFormation.

•
Troubleshoot and resolve cloud-related issues in a timely manner.

•
Collaborate with development teams to ensure smooth deployment and operation of
applications on AWS.

•
Stay up-to-date with the latest AWS services and technologies.


Education

•
2+ years of experience working with AWS cloud services.

•
Strong understanding of AWS core services (EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, RDS, etc.).

•
Experience with infrastructure as code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation).

•
Knowledge of scripting languages (Python, Bash).

•
Experience with cloud security best practices.

•
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.

•
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Bonus Points

•
Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

•
Certification in AWS (AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified DevOps
Engineer).

•
Experience with serverless computing (Lambda, API Gateway).
